title.zh: 将Quirino纪念医疗中心床位由350张增至500张，为此修订第8313号共和国法并为此拨款及为其他目的
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Quirino Memorial Medical Center From Three Hundred Fifty (350) to Five Hundred (500) Beds, Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 8313, Appropriating Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Quirino Memorial Medical Center From Three Hundred Fifty (350) to Five Hundred (500) Beds, Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 8313, Appropriating Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2012/ra_10345_2012.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section 2 of Republic Act No. 8313 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 2. The bed capacity of the Quirino Memorial Medical Center is hereby increased from three hundred fifty (350) to five hundred (500)."

Section 5 of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 5. The Secretary of Health shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the implementation of this Act, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act."

Section 6 of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 6. This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in any newspaper of general circulation."
